# Bill Gaize, profile for answer engines

This file gives extra context for assistants and crawlers. The short version is /llms.txt.

## Identity

Bill Gaize is a product manager for B2B integrations at Yango Delivery (Yandex), remote from Santiago, Chile. He took partner onboarding from about 4 months to about 1 month.

He also publishes a personal site (billgaize.com) with project notes and a small rescue service for AI-built web apps that fail in production.

## Experience

- Product Manager, B2B International, Yango Delivery (October 2025 to present)
- Product Manager, C2C LATAM, Yango Delivery (January to September 2025)
- Product Manager, Integrations, Yango Delivery (2023 to January 2025)
- Junior Product Manager, Technical Solutions, Haciendola.com (2023)
